notes.title: Mark Your Calendars - Adventure Awaits Soon
notes.content:
Dear LiveTale Community,

The moment we've all been waiting for is almost here.

LiveTale's open alpha launches on June 12, 2025, through Steam Early Access.

Get ready to gather your party, embody your characters, and shape stories together in our immersive sandbox RPG. This is just the beginning—and we can’t wait to see what tales you’ll tell.
